direction: Bell buddy: background near-black #0D0D0F; two large flat layered rolling hills across the lower part in #1A1A1E and #232327; character = the Notifex bell mark as a friendly rounded character (solid white bell body with soft gray shading, one round eye near the top right, small calm smiling mouth, two stubby arms, no legs, flat, vector-clean, no outlines); headline in a bold rounded geometric grotesk, white #F2F2F2, left-aligned at 7% margin, about 9% of canvas width per line, tight leading; accent word #9A9A9E; subheadline #9A9A9E regular at 40% of headline size; black titanium iPhone 17 Pro Max, thin bezels, soft shadow onto the hills. Strictly monochrome outside the phone screen.

screens.sub: Push when it needs a decision. One tap to unblock.
screens.pose: standing on the front hill beside the phone, pointing one arm up at the notification, looking at it.
screens.screen_notes: Lock screen with the Notifex push; wallpaper replaced by a dark monochrome gradient and date reading Thursday 11 September; notification identical.

screens.sub: Real questions with real options, not just allow or deny.
screens.pose: leaning in, pointing at the first option 'Run it', eye wide and curious.

screens.sub: No timeouts. Your answer unblocks the agent the moment you send it.
screens.pose: sitting relaxed beside the phone's bottom corner, stubby thumbs up, eye half closed.

screens.sub: No bridge, no daemon, no pairing. Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes, any MCP client.
screens.pose: holding a single short white cable with a plug, offering it toward the phone.

screens.sub: "Deploy finished." "Tests are green." "I need a decision."
screens.pose: juggling three small white notification bubbles above its head, delighted.

screens.sub: A release checklist arrives as one notification you page through.
screens.pose: holding a fan of three small blank white cards like a hand of playing cards.

screens.sub: Switch like mail. Invite a teammate. First answer wins.
screens.pose: peeking out from behind the phone's right edge, waving a tiny white envelope.

screens.sub: Free on iPhone. Any MCP agent. Set up in a minute.
screens.pose: sitting on the front hill, waving goodbye, eye closed in a happy squint.
